content.bio:
Peter Cat Recording Co. is a Delhi band built around singer and guitarist Suryakant Sawhney, who formed it in 2009 after leaving film school in San Francisco. With Rohan Kulshreshtha and a shifting set of friends it started out as a part-cabaret, part-folk, part-jazz outfit playing around the capital's small venues, and became known across India for a sound that mixes hot-club swing, old Hindi film music, lounge crooning and psychedelic rock.

Sawhney sings in a low, deadpan croon and has named the Velvet Underground and Neutral Milk Hotel as formative, as much for their home-made spirit as their songs. Over albums like Bismillah, Portrait of a Time and Sinema the band built an audience far beyond Delhi, playing festivals in Europe, Australia and the United States and becoming one of the best-known independent bands to come out of India.

album.title: Portrait of a Time
album.classicReason: Portrait of a Time (check title and year before writing) folds crooner vocals, brushed jazz drums and psychedelic guitar into songs that feel lifted from a 1960s film. "Floated By" sets its tumbling groove against Sawhney's weary half-spoken vocal. The band recorded much of it themselves, in keeping with the do-it-yourself ethos Sawhney credits to the Velvet Underground. It endures as the record that carried an independent Delhi band to audiences around the world.
